name: containerlab-app
description: Monorepo for Containerlab web, desktop, VS Code extension, and shared UI.

scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-app-web run dev
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-desktop run dev
scripts.build:web: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-app-web run build
scripts.build:pages: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-app-web run build:pages
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-desktop run build
scripts.package:desktop: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-desktop run package
scripts.package:desktop:linux: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-desktop run package:linux
scripts.package:desktop:mac: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-desktop run package:mac
scripts.package:desktop:win: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-desktop run package:win
scripts.dev:pages: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-app-web run dev:pages
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm run check:release-version && pnpm run check:deps && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm -r --if-present run lint
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm -r --if-present run test:unit
scripts.test:e2e:web: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-app-web run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:web:smoke: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter containerlab-app-web run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.build:vscode: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter vscode-containerlab run build
scripts.dev:vscode: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter vscode-containerlab run build:watch
scripts.package:vscode: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter vscode-containerlab run package
scripts.test:e2e:vscode: pnpm run build:clab-ui && pnpm --filter vscode-containerlab run test:e2e
